highlight.title: Gone
highlight.badge: BritBox Original · North America Premiere · July 23
highlight.description: David Morrissey (Sherwood) and Eve Myles (Torchwood, Keeping Faith) lead this six-part thriller. Bristol music teacher Sarah Polly vanishes without a trace, and her husband Michael turns to the police — but Detective Annie Cassidy suspects he's hiding something. Twisty, tense, and one of BritBox's most talked-about new arrivals.

new_arrivals.title: Gone
new_arrivals.description: A married music teacher from Bristol disappears, and her husband becomes the focus of a tense police investigation. Three episodes on release, then weekly — a gripping mystery starring David Morrissey and Eve Myles.

new_arrivals.title: A Woman of Substance
new_arrivals.description: Brenda Blethyn and Jessica Reynolds share the role of Emma Harte in this sweeping saga of a Yorkshire maid's rise to a global business empire. Based on Barbara Taylor Bradford's beloved novel — the 1984 original miniseries with Jenny Seagrove joins BritBox July 29 for anyone who wants to compare.

new_arrivals.title: Grace
new_arrivals.description: John Simm returns as Detective Superintendent Roy Grace for a sixth season of feature-length mysteries based on Peter James's bestselling novels. Months after a major arrest, Grace and his team face devastating new cases across Brighton.

new_arrivals.title: Return to Paradise
new_arrivals.description: Detective Sergeant Mackenzie Clarke is back in Dolphin Cove, juggling high-stakes murder investigations with the messy reality of her personal life. The sun-soaked Death in Paradise spin-off returns with new episodes weekly.

new_arrivals.title: Escape to the Country
new_arrivals.description: The long-running favorite returns, following prospective buyers as they hunt for their dream rural retreat with the help of expert presenters. The ultimate comfort watch — property tours, local history, and gorgeous countryside.

originals.title: Happy Valley
originals.description: Sarah Lancashire won every award going for her portrayal of West Yorkshire police sergeant Catherine Cawood. One of the finest performances in British TV history. Intense, perfectly written, and utterly unmissable.

originals.title: Trigger Point
originals.description: Vicky McClure is magnetic as explosives officer Lana Washington. Each series is a taut, gripping thriller with real stakes and superb performances — all three seasons now streaming.

originals.title: Beyond Paradise
originals.description: The warmest, most charming spin-off British TV has produced. Kris Marshall's Humphrey Goodman is irresistible, the Devon and Cornwall setting is gorgeous, and the mysteries are the perfect combination of puzzling and cozy.

originals.title: The Other Bennet Sister
originals.description: A genuinely fresh take on the Austen universe — witty, warm, and anchored by a wonderful lead performance from Ella Bruccoleri. Series 1 just wrapped; a three-part Christmas special is on the way later this year.
